title: The Work orders sub-toggles are shown but disabled when Work orders View is OFF
preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role) with Work orders View OFF.
steps:
1. Find the Work orders card.
  2. Find the three sub-toggles Review work orders, Pick parts and Order parts.
  3. Look at their state.
  4. Try to click each one.
expected:
All three sub-toggles are shown inside the Work orders card but appear greyed out / disabled.

Clicking them does not turn them on.
